caption: One K-means iteration on the six spends. Starting from c1=1200 and c2=5000, the low group's mean becomes ₹1250 and the high group's mean becomes ₹5100; the assignments do not change.

spec.aria: A flowchart of one K-means iteration: starting from c1=1200 and c2=5000, the low group 1200, 1300, 1250 is assigned to c1 and its mean becomes 1250; the high group 5000, 5200, 5100 is assigned to c2 and its mean becomes 5100; assignments do not change, so it converges, and K-means is a partitioning method.
